name: Awakening
description: The operative awakens on the ringworld surface. Lia detects a construct signature. Something feels familiar, like a corrupted save file from a previous run.

objectives.description: Follow Lia's guidance to the Oracle Prime
Survive the initial seeker bot swarm

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Systems online. I am with you. The surface readings are... wrong. This place feels familiar, like a level we've already completed.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: There. The construct's energy signature matches the data fragments. If this is a simulation, I can't find the edge of the world.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: You carry the signal of the builders. I have waited centuries for this contact. Though, between you and me, some of my brothers started malfunctioning after the first update.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: The ringworld was designed as an ark. It is now a prison. Something has broken the seals. I can see the patches didn't hold.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Shade
dialogue.line: Interference detected. The intruder must be purged before the protocols fail. Don't make me reload my ammo count from a previous checkpoint.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: The chamber is destabilizing. We need to move—now. Try not to fall through the floor on the way out; I hate clipping through geometry.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Well, that wasn't in the collision mesh. If you can see the bottom of the map, you've found the developers' favorite testing area.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Fascinating. Your equipment is displaying corrupted text. This happens when someone mods the asset files without understanding the memory layout.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Your magazine is not depleting. Either you've found a legendary artifact, or someone spawned this with a debug flag. I'm logging it as the latter.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Casual mode selected. The AI will pretend it can't see you sometimes. I've adjusted the matchmaking to be more forgiving.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Shade
dialogue.line: Legend mode. No artificial difficulty. Just raw, unbalanced combat. Don't come crying to me when you get outflanked by a sentry bot with better tactics than your squad.

easter_eggs.name: Warthog Launch
easter_eggs.description: Vehicle launches into the sky. A classic testing bug turned feature.

easter_eggs.name: Glitch Text
easter_eggs.description: Screen displays corrupted text. The asset cache is rejecting malformed glyphs.

easter_eggs.name: Infinite Ammo
easter_eggs.description: Weapon never reloads. Someone definitely edited the ammo tables.
